findings.location: HTML, poem, line beginning “Falou-lhe de Jesus”
findings.source_quote: He told him of Jesus, his life He’d transform.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace only this line with: “Falou-lhe de Jesus, que transformaria sua vida.” This removes the added claim “com amor” while preserving the source’s meaning.
findings.translation_quote: Falou-lhe de Jesus, que transformaria sua vida com amor.

findings.location: HTML, poem, line beginning “E ele soube”
findings.source_quote: He knew with no doubt that he was made whole.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace only this line with: “E soube, sem dúvida, que havia sido restaurado por completo.” The current wording shifts the claim from the person being made whole to his life being restored.
findings.translation_quote: E ele soube, sem dúvida, que sua vida fora restaurada.
